issues.location: even-number valuation in the positive-integer model
issues.finding: The source fixes W as the positive integers but defines V(p) using 2n for n in Nat. The book defines Nat as including 0, so this valuation contains 0 outside W.
issues.proposed_resolution: Index the even-number valuation by positive integers in the target, yielding exactly the positive even worlds shown in the diagram.

issues.location: p and q valuations in the binary-tree exercise
issues.finding: The tree's W consists only of binary strings starting with 0, while the two valuation set builders also generate strings starting with 1. A model valuation must assign subsets of W; the diagram labels only worlds in W.
issues.proposed_resolution: Intersect each target valuation set builder with W, preserving the depicted truth assignments on the tree.

translation_treatment: Translated finest and coarsest filtration proofs, the positive-integer quotient example, figure caption and binary-tree exercise with two bounded valuation-domain repairs.
